<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def robotN(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rows)>=50:  # robot N (lower)
                cols=[p[1] for p in b]; return (min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def midWhite(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if 24<=min(rows) and max(rows)<=39:
                cols=[p[1] for p in b]; return (min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels'])
    return None
print('start robotN',robotN(current_frame),'midW',midWhite(current_frame))
for i in range(4):
    r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}])
    res=last_action_result
    rn=robotN(current_frame)
    print('click',i,'robotN',rn,'midW',midWhite(current_frame),
          'lvl',res.get('level_completed'),'done',res.get('done'),'noimp',res.get('no_impact'))
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('no_impact'):
        break
</parameter>
